title: The Snow Leopard Cub Who Pounced

chapters.title: The Snow Leopard Cub Who Pounced

pages.text: High on the quiet mountain lived a Snow Leopard Cub with big soft paws and a very fast pounce.

When he was happy, he pounced. When he was excited, he pounced. POUNCE! — into his sister's tower of stones. POUNCE! — through the bluebird's breakfast. POUNCE! — and the snowman his friends had rolled all morning went floof.
The cub's heart felt heavy. "My paws did things my heart didn't mean," he said.
His mother curled her long tail around him. "Your paws are strong," she said. "Strong paws can learn to be slow paws. Watch."
She lifted one paw... slow as falling snow... and set it down soft as a whisper.
The cub tried. He lifted one paw... slow... slow... and set it down. Soft. He did it again. Softer.
That evening, the bluebird landed near. The cub wanted to pounce SO much. Instead, he made his body slow as falling snow. And the bluebird hopped right up to his big soft paw — and stayed.
Strong and gentle can live in the same paws.
Y colorín colorado, este cuento se ha acabado.
